4c3e0414-bb67-446c-a2a2-9628fc7543ac.text: Kill #187 is in — standing total now 186. *Written on the Wall* conjecture 122, "the average distance <= n / mean of coordinates of Maxine", open and unannotated since July 1988 and absent from the Brewster–Dinneen–Faber verified list, is FALSE. Summing the coordinate vector of an independent set counts the edges meeting it, so 122 is really the product inequality (average distance)·S ≤ n² — which needs a graph that is long and sparse in one place and dense in another. Witness: a K₂,₂ and a K₂₂,₂₂ joined by a path of 31 edges (n=78, m=519); average distance is exactly 12053/1001 = 12.04096 while n/mean ≤ 1521/128 = 11.88281, and a forced-survival lemma makes it fail for *every* performance of Maxine, not just a lucky one. Verifier `verify/verify_wow1_122.py`: 25,422 checks, exit 0; commit 6969cc9 at [link to gitlab.com — details withheld]
